recommendations: Mario Estevez-Cruz “Shaghayegh joined my team as an intern, and worked on a time-bound project for 3 months. During this short amount of time, I got to witness first-hand her strong SWE foundation skills, ability to quickly learn new technologies, and see the growth in her confidence to converse technically with senior engineers within my team. I also saw her effectiveness in communicating the problem area, solution, and potential enhancements to less technical individuals such as Directors and Senior Managers during her final project presentation. She not only fully delivered the initial project scope, but went above and beyond in suggesting alternative solutions to parts of the initial project plan that provided even more impact despite the fact that it would add more work and potentially impact the delivery of her project. Shaghayegh exceeded my expectations, as she delivered a fully working tool that is now currently used to lower operational costs in our platform and lower resource utilization costs. It was a joy having her work in my team. She has huge potential with her current technical skills, amazing work etiquette, willingness to learn, receptiveness to feedback and ability to work well with others. I recommended her for a conversion at the end of her internship, and really hope to see her at LinkedIn again after she graduates.”

Qazale Khalafi “I've known shaghayegh for 8 years. she is always trying her best to learn new things. She is a genius and also a responsible, honest and hardworking girl. I would strongly recommend her for any position or career she chooses to pursue and I have no doubt she will be successful in her future endeavors.”
